_comment: MSc DFinTech application document rules for MVP. Based on NUS Computing application information and DFT database. Mandatory docs are uploaded online before submission. GMAT/GRE/GATE is treated as optional/supporting because DFT admission notes say it is not mandatory. Every item declares a `requirement` level: required (blocks the application) | conditional (applies only if a fact the profile does not record is true; surfaced for confirmation) | supporting (optional).

base_items.label: Personal Statement
base_items.why: Explains your reasons for applying, preparation for the field, career plans, and relevant background.

base_items.label: Curriculum Vitae / CV
base_items.why: Summarises your education, work/internship experience, projects, achievements and readiness for the programme.

base_items.label: Proof of Residence / Passport / NRIC
base_items.why: Confirms your identity and residence status for the online application.

base_items.label: Official Degree Certificate / Expected Graduation Letter
base_items.why: Confirms award or expected completion of your Bachelor’s degree or higher degree.

base_items.label: Official Transcript(s)
base_items.why: Verifies your academic record and must show grades for all courses taken.

base_items.label: Two Referee Reports
base_items.why: At least two referee reports are required through the online application system.

base_items.label: Application Fee Payment
base_items.why: Only submitted applications with the S$109 application fee paid by the deadline will be processed.

base_items.label: GRE / GMAT / GATE Score Report
base_items.why: Not mandatory according to current programme notes, but useful as supporting evidence if available.

base_items.label: Financial Support Document
base_items.why: A bank statement, payslip or sponsor letter can be uploaded as evidence of financial support.

base_items.label: Other Supporting Documents
base_items.why: Upload awards, professional certificates or other supporting evidence if applicable.

conditional_items.label: TOEFL / IELTS Score Report
conditional_items.why: Required only if your previous university education was not mainly taught in English. Your profile does not record the medium of instruction, so please confirm it — if that degree was taught in English, this item may not apply to you.

conditional_items.label: Statement on Academic Performance
conditional_items.why: Optional supporting statement, not an official document requirement. Your recorded degree classification is below second-upper (2:1), so a short note on your academic record and any relevant context helps the reviewer read it in full.

_comment_english_medium: Institutions whose degrees are known to be taught in English. Used ONLY to waive the TOEFL/IELTS item; an institution that is absent stays 'unconfirmed' (the applicant is asked, never told). Seeded from local_institution_keywords (Singapore universities, already treated as English-exempt via english_exempt_countries); extend with sourced entries only.
